targetTest: An empty marketplace argument is rejected with a message that names its field - #1.1
expected: One usage-error payload per command whose message names the empty field: Source must not be empty. for marketplace add with an empty or blank source; Marketplace name must not be empty. for remove, info, update (empty and blank), autoupdate, and noautoupdate with an empty name; Plugin name must not be empty. for uninstall (empty and blank), enable, and disable with an empty <plugin>@<marketplace> ref. Each payload keeps kind usage-error, severity error, needs reload false, and the verb's own usage line.
actual: The same payloads with today's messages: Missing required argument. for add, remove, info, uninstall, enable, and disable, and the generic Argument must not be empty. for update, autoupdate, and noautoupdate.
semanticAssessment: All twelve scenarios (eight rows of the marketplace Outline in features/marketplace/usage-errors.feature and four rows of the plugin Outline in features/plugin/usage-errors.feature) started Pi and ran their command, then failed only at the result has these fields step. In each, the kind, severity, needs reload, and usage rows matched; the one difference is the message row. The parser today reports the usage (mapped to Missing required argument.) for an empty required positional and the generic Argument must not be empty. for an empty optional one, so no message names the field. This is the D-05 defect.
